products.name: Gemini for Education
products.note: AI: Chat assistant, Gemini in Classroom. Who: Teachers; students of all ages when admin enables. Student age: All ages in Workspace for Education when enabled by admin; stricter content policies and youth onboarding for users under 18. Privacy: Core Service under Google Workspace for Education Terms; chats not reviewed by humans or used to train models; supports FERPA and COPPA compliance. Price: Free in all Workspace for Education editions; Google AI Pro for Education paid add-on, 18+ only.

products.name: Google Meet notes (Take notes for me)
products.note: AI: Summaries, action items, transcripts. Who: Staff. Student age: Requires Google AI Pro for Education, which is available only to users 18 and over. Privacy: Workspace for Education terms. Price: Google AI Pro for Education add-on: $15 per user per month promotional, $20 list, annual commitment.

products.name: Google Teachable Machine
products.note: AI: Trains image, sound, and pose models. Who: Students grades 3 to 12, teachers. Student age: No login required. Privacy: Training data stays on the device unless the user saves to Google Drive or uploads a model. Price: Free.

products.name: Google NotebookLM
products.note: AI: Source-grounded study guides, Q&A, mind maps and audio overviews from uploaded material. Who: Teachers and students in Google Workspace for Education; consumers 13+. Student age: All ages in Google Workspace for Education when the admin turns it on, with stricter content policies under 18; consumers 13+ or the country minimum. Privacy: Core Service under the Google Workspace for Education terms; chats and sources not human reviewed or used to train models; supports FERPA and COPPA compliance. Price: Included free in all Google Workspace for Education editions.
